extra.reason: Added and verified make dev runner with clean shutdown for both FastAPI and Vite.

Removed header, footer, and metadata cards. Converted the viewer into an automatic human-Black versus FlyGo-White game with a backend-authoritative /api/play endpoint, turn reducer hook, and browser-verified captures, pass, and game over.
Board size now flows through the rules, features, model head, and API. The web app is a WGo-style canvas board with size, New, and Pass controls plus one status word.
Padding now derives from the cell size, so the margin always exceeds the stone radius.
Added tested 5x5 validation and standard 19x19 production support, regenerated conformance and browser artifacts, and removed intermediate-size policies.
Added validated SGF ingestion, deterministic complete-game splits, policy-value NPZ datasets, KataGo query generation and response import, provenance manifests, CLI commands, and end-to-end tests.

Added end-to-end NumPy training through frozen recurrent dynamics, dihedral augmentation, policy and value losses, graph-bound checkpoints, trained browser exports, CLI training, and policy-value conformance tests.

Added deadline and visit-budget PUCT search, exact terminal evaluation, paired color-swapped tournaments, deterministic internal agents, regularized Elo fitting, paired bootstrap confidence intervals, reports, CLI benchmarking, and tests.

Added browser PUCT search, policy-value evaluation, a one-second Web Worker, asynchronous game handling, search telemetry, unit tests, production build artifacts, favicon, and successful real-browser verification at 19x19.
Deduplicated canonical board and side-to-move features globally before writing split files, recorded duplicate counts, and added leakage regression coverage.
Verified CLI training, checkpoint inference, exported-weight conformance, and finite-difference gradients. All 71 Python tests, Ruff, BasedPyright, and vulture pass.
Added immutable disconnected and weight-shuffled controls and simple-graph degree-preserving edge swaps. All 73 Python tests, Ruff, and BasedPyright pass.
